Dear Mr. Phillips,

Re: Account reference: ACC-372793

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the amount owed on your account with us. We appreciate the opportunity to review your concerns and provide a response.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a validation notice, which includes the amount of the debt, the name of the original creditor, and a statement that unless you dispute the validity of this debt, we will assume it is valid. We confirm that the original creditor for this account is Frontier State Bank.

Upon reviewing your dispute, we note that you have questioned the accuracy of certain charges on your account. We will investigate these claims and verify the accuracy of the charges. We will also review our records to ensure that all charges are properly documented and compliant with applicable laws.

In accordance with Colorado Revised Statutes, Section 5-3-104, we are required to provide you with a written acknowledgment of your dispute. We acknowledge your dispute and will conduct a thorough review of your account.

Please be advised that we will provide you with a written response to your dispute, including any findings or conclusions, within 30 days of receipt of your dispute. If we determine that any charges were incorrectly applied, we will take the necessary steps to correct the account and provide a revised balance.

You have the right to further dispute this debt if you believe that the amount is still incorrect after our review. Please note that you may request a written verification of the debt, which we will provide to you.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
